title: Figure 12: Plan and side view comparison of FDL-7C/D (1962) and Model 176 (1964)
description: Scaled plan-view and side-view line drawings of two hypersonic glider configurations, labeled "FDL-7 C/D Modified" ("circa 1962") on top and "Model 176 Modified" ("circa 1964") below, each with a "5 meters" scale bar and centerline. Caption: "Figure 12. Comparison of FDL-7C/D (top) and Model 176 (bottom)." Text compares the McDonnell Douglas Model 176 power-law nose and X-tail with the FDL-7C/D.
